status: Written before new data download and v2 training. SciFact, NFCorpus, ArguAna and SciDocs are reused development/regression collections. FiQA test is a new locally uninspected evaluation set, not a claim of absence from upstream model pretraining.
hypotheses: domain-balanced sampling prevents NFCorpus volume from dominating the objective
linear-gain delta-nDCG@10 weighted pair loss better matches the evaluation target
query/document role features and pretrained cross-encoder teacher scores provide richer supervision
a contraction-mapped attention recurrence prevents state divergence at extra passes; convergence is not an accuracy guarantee
candidate expansion improves the attainable ranking ceiling
new-domain evaluation and unmodified strong baselines reveal whether changes transfer
data: Reuse exact v1 SciFact/NFCorpus train, tune and calibration assignments; check normalized query overlap with FiQA dev/test. FiQA dev supplies calibration only after model selection is frozen; FiQA train unused. The four old public test sets are regression-only.
candidates: Union dense top96, hybrid top96 and BM25 top64, at most256; eligible-corpus normalization before self-exclusion ranking. Compare old 48/48/32 candidate recall and oracle nDCG ceilings. No label-based positive injection.
architecture: Width64, input normalized query, document, product, absolute difference and six retrieval features. Correction bounded +/-1. No-attention baseline and fixed-input attention P with shared h_next=0.5*u+0.5*tanh(P@(h*tanh(diagonal))). P nonnegative row-stochastic; max-row-L2 contraction at most0.5. Train recurrence depths2/4/8, frozen inference depth4. No claim of implementing a full DEQ solver or of improved foundation-model attention.
loss: Delta linear-nDCG@10 weighted logistic pairs plus 0.01 squared residual anchor. Judged-positive versus unjudged pairs retain the usual incomplete-judgment caveat. Distilled recipe adds0.1 centered teacher-margin MSE on all eligible candidates; teacher labels are predictions, not ground truth. No-positive lists contribute teacher/anchor losses rather than fabricated positive labels.
selection: Checkpoint and recipe/seed selected on equal-domain mean tune nDCG only, including epoch0. Deployment candidates selected per training domain on tuning among dense, hybrid, teacher and fixed 50/50 z-normalized hybrid/teacher scores. Selected student also eligible. New FiQA uses globally selected tuning method. Independent calibration applies one-sided paired-bootstrap lower gain gates with Bonferroni correction for three comparisons versus dense/hybrid/teacher; insufficient or negative bounds fall back to dense. Existing calibration is reused and cannot be rebranded untouched.
metric: Linear-gain nDCG@10, recall@10, MRR@10, candidate recall and oracle nDCG@10. Bootstrap10000 resamples seed20260926. Report all nine models; no selecting a seed from test scores.
timing: Full-corpus retrieval plus online teacher/student ranking of preencoded queries, excluding query encoding and reader generation; teacher includes tokenization and transfers. Clearly separate offline cached training scores from online reranking cost.
release: Experimental opt-in, no default change unless comparative evidence qualifies. Preserve v1 evidence. No paid endpoints. Public source and derived artifacts only; no base weights or raw corpus publication.
